summary: Galaxy Digital Inc. filed an 8-K announcing that its indirect wholly-owned subsidiary, Galaxy Helios Data Centers II LLC, priced an offering of $3.507 billion aggregate principal amount of 9.875% Senior Secured Notes due 2031. The offering will be sold to qualified institutional buyers under Rule 144A and to non-U.S. persons under Regulation S. Closing is expected on July 28, 2026, subject to market and customary conditions. This is a debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. No price per share, premium, or M&A terms are involved. The notes are senior secured, and proceeds will be used per the company's plans. Watch for closing conditions and interest rate environment impacts.
